PRIVACY NOTICE

Clear about what
we collect and why.

Last updated 24 September 2026. This notice covers the Fabrication Intelligence pilot website, quote requests and client or manufacturer accounts.

What we collect

When you submit a request, we may collect your name, email, company, project details, product requirements, timing, destination and an optional drawing. Account users also provide login details and a client or manufacturer profile. Manufacturer applicants may provide company capabilities, certifications and website information.

Why we use it

We use this information to understand and respond to sourcing requests, prepare comparable quote options, operate accounts, review manufacturer applications, protect private files and improve the pilot.

Where it is stored

Website source code is stored in GitHub and the website is hosted through Vercel and GitHub Pages. Personal account and request data is stored in Supabase, not in the public source repository. Account, request and private upload data is handled through Supabase. Passwords are handled by Supabase Auth and are not visible to the Fabrication Intelligence team. Private drawings and supplier files are not public. When you submit a quote request, its details (but not your drawing) are also emailed to the FI team through FormSubmit so we can reply quickly.

Who can access it

Approved FI team accounts can access quote requests and files needed to operate the service. Clients can access only requests linked to their own signed-in account. Manufacturer applicants can access only their own application; approval status is controlled separately by FI. Approved supplier workspaces remain invitation-only.

Payments and marketing

The pilot does not take payments online. We do not sell your personal information. We do not add you to marketing messages merely because you submitted a request.

Retention and your choices

We keep pilot records only for as long as reasonably needed to respond, operate the service and document the project. To ask for access, correction or deletion, email s4149874@student.rmit.edu.au. Some records may need to be retained where required by law or legitimate project administration.

Pilot status

This is a student-led pilot, not a final automated marketplace. The service may change as the team learns from early users. Material privacy changes will be reflected on this page.
